Technology stocks were firming Tuesday.
Among technology stocks that should move on news:
- Aviat Networks ( AVNW ) fell over 1% after-hours on Monday after the mobile communications equipment company said it was eliminating 34 positions as part of a realignment plan to lower costs and improve profitability. Aviat is projecting around $3 million in charges spread against its financial results for its fiscal Q4 ending June 30 and during the first two quarters of its FY19. It also sees the moves generating about $1.2 million in FY19 savings and rising to $3.2 million in FY20. Separately, the company late Monday said it hired Stan Gallagher for the newly created role as chief operating officer, joining Aviat from Synergetics Installations Worldwide, where he was director of operational excellence and supply chain management during the past three years.
In other sector news:
= Simulations Plus ( SLP ) was unchanged just before Tuesday's opening bell after the software firm said Shawn O'Connor was its new chief executive officer, succeeding Walt Woltosz, who will remain board chairman following his retirement. O'Connor recently was CEO at Entelos, which provides quantitative systems pharmacology software and services.
